title: A Sky Full of Stars
exercise_name: A Sky Full of Stars · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《A Sky Full Of Stars》描寫一份充滿希望、光芒與無私付出的深刻愛情。歌中的主角將心愛的人比喻為佈滿星星的天空，因為對方就像黑暗中的星光，照亮了他的人生，帶來溫暖與方向。即使愛情可能伴隨傷害與痛苦，他仍然願意毫無保留地交出自己的真心，勇敢去愛。他相信無論生活變得多麼艱難，對方的存在都能讓世界重新充滿光明。歌曲亦表達了對愛人的欣賞與珍惜，彷彿她是生命中最美麗的風景。最終，《A Sky Full Of Stars》傳達的是愛情中的希望、勇氣與奉獻：真正深刻的愛能在最黑暗的時刻，成為照亮人生的力量。

vocabulary.usage: 形容一個地方或東西有很多某種事物。
options: The lift is full of actors in giant hats.
My bag full of is books.
I full of to school every day.
The hotel is full of at midnight.
vocabulary.explanation: full of 表示裝滿；電梯裡都是戴大帽子的演員。
optionExplanations: full of 表示裝滿；電梯裡都是戴大帽子的演員。
錯誤：full of 的位置不對；應說 My bag is full of books.
錯誤：full of 不是「去」的意思；應說 I go to school every day.
full of 後面要接人或物，at midnight 只表示時間。

vocabulary.meaning: 將要、打算（going to 的口語說法）
vocabulary.usage: 用在聊天或歌曲中，說自己接下來打算做的事；正式寫作宜用 going to。
options: I gonna call the boss after the meeting.
We are gonna watch a movie tonight.
She is gonna goes home now.
My new phone is gonna very clever.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：be gonna 加原形動詞，表示今晚打算看電影。
optionExplanations: gonna 前面缺少 am；應說 I am gonna call。
正確：be gonna 加原形動詞，表示今晚打算看電影。
錯誤：gonna 後面要用原形動詞 go，不是 goes。
gonna 後面要接動詞原形，不能直接接 very clever。

vocabulary.usage: 燈光照亮房間或道路時使用，也可比喻讓人開心。
options: I light up my bus ticket to pay the driver.
The small lamp lights up my room.
She light up to the bus at eight.
The screen turns light up my message.
optionExplanations: 買車票或付款應用 buy 或 pay；light up 表示照亮。
正確：小燈讓房間變亮。
錯誤：light up 不是搭車；應說 She takes the bus at eight.
這個語序不成立；可說 The screen lights up。

vocabulary.usage: 當某件事對你不重要，或你不介意某個選擇時使用；語氣有時可能顯得直接。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「I don't care」？
options: I don't care my bag on the chair.
I don't care to blue the sky.
Choose any film. I don't care; I love them all.
I don't care is seven o'clock.
vocabulary.explanation: I don't care 表示不介意選哪一部電影。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：care 不能這樣直接接物品；若要說放包包，可說 I put my bag on the chair.
錯誤：blue 不是這裡可用的動詞；可以說 I don't care if the sky is grey.
I don't care 表示不介意選哪一部電影。
錯誤：缺少 if 或 that 等連接方式；可說 I don't care if it is late.

vocabulary.usage: 鼓勵別人接著說、接著做，或表示某件事持續發生。
options: Go on the window because it is cold.
I go on my bank card to buy a ticket.
She goes on a happy yesterday.
Go on. Your story is better than this film.
vocabulary.explanation: go on 是請對方繼續，這裡請他繼續說故事。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：這裡應使用 close the window，而不是 go on the window.
使用銀行卡應用 use；go on 沒有這種用法。
錯誤：go on 後面不能這樣接形容詞和 yesterday；可說 She was happy yesterday.
go on 是請對方繼續，這裡請他繼續說故事。

vocabulary.meaning: 撕開、撕碎；使人非常難過
vocabulary.usage: 可用於撕壞紙張，也可比喻讓一個人的心情很痛苦。
options: The child tore the old paper apart.
He tears apart the music with his ears.
I tear apart the water to drink it.
She tear apart to the library.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：tore 是 tear 的過去式，表示把紙撕開。
optionExplanations: 正確：tore 是 tear 的過去式，表示把紙撕開。
錯誤：聽音樂不使用 tear apart；應說 He listens to music.
錯誤：水不能被「撕開」；應說 I drink the water.
錯誤：tear apart 不是前往某地；應說 She goes to the library.

vocabulary.usage: 形容一個人被另一個人抱住，常見於親密或安慰的情境。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「in your arms」？
options: I in your arms the train to work.
We book in your arms a room for two.
I walk in your arms to the shop alone.
The baby is sleeping in her dad’s arms.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：寶寶在爸爸懷裡睡覺。
optionExplanations: in your arms 是位置片語，不能當作乘火車的動詞。
訂房可說 book a room；in your arms 表示在懷裡。
錯誤：一個人走去商店，不適合用 in your arms；應說 I walk to the shop alone.
正確：寶寶在爸爸懷裡睡覺。

vocabulary.usage: 用來說兩件事會一起改變；也常說 the more..., the better...。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「the more..., the more...」？
options: The more I sleep, the more my pencil is blue.
The more I practise, the better I get.
I the more study, the more English.
The more eat I, the more happy.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：練習越多，就進步越多。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：睡眠與鉛筆顏色沒有合理的關係，無法清楚表達一起變化。
正確：練習越多，就進步越多。
錯誤：缺少完整子句；可以說 The more I study, the more I learn.
錯誤：語序不對；可以說 The more I eat, the happier I feel.

vocabulary.usage: 放在形容詞加單數可數名詞之前，加強讚美或驚訝的語氣。
options: I such a go home now.
She is such a very happily.
It is such a beautiful day!
These are such a funny films.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：such a 後接 beautiful day，表示今天真美好。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：such a 不能用在 go home 前；應說 I go home now.
錯誤：such a 後面需要單數可數名詞，happily 是副詞。
正確：such a 後接 beautiful day，表示今天真美好。
films 是複數，such 後面應省去 a。

vocabulary.usage: 讚美風景、食物或聲音非常美好時使用。這個字較進階，但例句保持簡單。
options: Her voice sounds heavenly; even Dad stops talking.
I heavenly my screen before a video call.
He goes heavenly to work at eight.
This heavenly is my new red bag.
vocabulary.explanation: heavenly 形容聲音美妙；爸爸都安靜下來了。
optionExplanations: heavenly 形容聲音美妙；爸爸都安靜下來了。
heavenly 是形容詞，不能作「清潔」的動詞。
錯誤：heavenly 不用來表示去上班；應說 He goes to work at eight.
錯誤：heavenly 不能單獨當成這裡的名詞；可說 This is my beautiful new red bag.

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依本次提供的核對版材料編排；程度標籤為教學參考。

questions.meaning: 照亮道路；比喻提供方向
questions.usage: 可用於照明，也能比喻某個人或建議指引前路。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「light up the path」（依上述意思）？
options: Her clear advice lit up the path when the plan felt confusing.
The new rule lit up the path by hiding the directions.
The empty map lit up the path by removing every street name.
The broken sign lit up the path by pointing in four wrong ways.
optionExplanations: 正確。清晰建議讓人找到方向，符合比喻。
錯誤。隱藏方向與指引相反。
錯誤。刪掉街名不會提供方向。
錯誤。錯誤指示不等於照亮道路。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：light up the path）。
questions.explanation: 正確。清晰建議讓人找到方向，符合比喻。

questions.meaning: 使我痛苦不堪；讓我心碎
questions.usage: 本題測感情受創的比喻義，不是撕紙的字面義。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「tear me apart」（依上述意思）？
options: The sad news tore me apart, and I could hardly speak.
The warm tea tore me apart, and I felt calm at once.
The funny joke tore me apart, and I slept peacefully.
The free ticket tore me apart, and I danced with joy.
optionExplanations: 正確。傷心消息令說話者極度痛苦，最符合此義。
錯誤。平靜的茶與痛苦不堪相矛盾。
錯誤。開心的笑話及安睡不支持悲痛義。
錯誤。喜悅跳舞與「心碎」相反。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：tear me apart）。
questions.explanation: 正確。傷心消息令說話者極度痛苦，最符合此義。

questions.meaning: 把真心交給你；全心信任或愛你
questions.usage: 以心象徵深情與投入；不表示真的交出身體器官。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「give you my heart」（依上述意思）？
options: The nurse gave you my heart inside a paper shopping bag.
The builder gave you my heart with a hammer and nails.
I gave you my heart because I trusted you completely.
The waiter gave you my heart with two plates of pasta.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。把心臟當商品交付，不是本題比喻義。
錯誤。錘子和釘子無法表達情感投入。
正確。全然信任並交付感情，符合比喻。
錯誤。餐點服務不能自然表示付出真心。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：give you my heart）。
questions.explanation: 正確。全然信任並交付感情，符合比喻。

questions.meaning: 變得更明亮；變得較輕
questions.usage: 歌曲中是黑暗中越發明亮；本題選「亮度變強」的意思。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「get lighter」（依上述意思）？
options: The bag got lighter when we painted it a deeper black.
The sky got lighter as the sun began to rise.
The road got lighter when the streetlamps went out.
The room got lighter when we closed every curtain.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。塗深黑可能談色彩，但此處不自然表示變亮。
正確。日出後天空逐漸明亮，符合語義。
錯誤。路燈熄滅通常讓路更暗。
錯誤。關緊窗簾通常使室內更暗。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：get lighter）。
questions.explanation: 正確。日出後天空逐漸明亮，符合語義。

questions.meaning: 美妙得像天堂一樣；極其美好
questions.usage: 可讚賞食物、聲音、風景或氣氛；不是字面上「位於天堂」。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、最正確地使用「heavenly」（依上述意思）？
options: The burnt soup tasted heavenly because everyone spat it out.
The broken alarm sounded heavenly, and everyone covered their ears.
The muddy water tasted heavenly because it smelled of petrol.
The choir sounded heavenly, and the hall fell silent.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。難吃到吐出來的湯不適合讚為 heavenly。
錯誤。刺耳警報與美妙的聲音相反。
錯誤。汽油味的泥水不符合美好的讚賞。
正確。合唱美妙動聽，令人屏息，使用自然。
questions.sourceWitness: ✅ 已在原歌詞核實（教師核對片段：heavenly）。
questions.explanation: 正確。合唱美妙動聽，令人屏息，使用自然。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依本次提供的核對版材料編排；歌曲線索與教學改寫分開呈現。

questions.meaning: 用後面的原因解釋前面的事；’cause 是歌曲中的口語縮寫。
questions.usage: 想回答「為甚麼？」或解釋一個結果時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The flowers grew because we forgot to plant any flowers.
The flowers grew because we watered them every day.
I wore sunglasses because I wanted the sun to shine inside my eyes.
The fish can fly because it has a bicycle.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：連花也沒有種，不能用這個原因解釋花朵生長。
正確：每天澆水能解釋花朵生長，因果關係合理。
錯誤：戴太陽眼鏡是為了減少陽光入眼，所說目的相反。
錯誤：魚擁有單車並不能解釋牠會飛，因果不成立。
questions.sourceWitness: ’Cause · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: The plants grew because we gave them water.
questions.explanation: 正確：每天澆水能解釋花朵生長，因果關係合理。

questions.meaning: 用一個名詞比喻另一個人或事物，表達相似的特質，而非字面身份。
questions.usage: 想用簡單而有畫面感的方式讚美、形容或表達感受時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: My uncle is a real train; he has wheels and runs on the railway every morning.
The new teacher is a warm light for us; she helps us feel safe.
My sister is the moon because she lives on the moon and is made of rock.
Our football coach is a clock, so we must put batteries in his back.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：句子把人描述成真的火車，沒有建立合理的比喻。
正確：把老師比作溫暖的光，是形容她令人安心的比喻。
錯誤：句子主張妹妹真的住在月球且由岩石構成，並非恰當比喻。
錯誤：把教練當成要裝電池的時鐘，沒有合理的比喻關係。
questions.sourceWitness: you’re a sky · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: My grandma is the sun in our family.
questions.explanation: 正確：把老師比作溫暖的光，是形容她令人安心的比喻。

questions.meaning: 表示某處或某物充滿某種東西。
questions.usage: 想具體描述一個地方、容器或畫面裏有很多甚麼時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The beach was full of people on the sunny holiday.
The tank is full of fish, but there are no fish in it at all.
The empty basket was full of apples, but nobody had put anything in it.
This glass is full of songs, so I can drink the music.
optionExplanations: 正確：晴天假期沙灘有很多人，full of 的描述合理。
錯誤：前後同時說魚缸有很多魚和完全沒有魚，互相矛盾。
錯誤：籃子既是空的又裝滿蘋果，說法矛盾。
錯誤：歌曲不能像飲料一樣裝在玻璃杯中供人喝。
questions.sourceWitness: sky full of stars · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: We found a box full of old letters.
questions.explanation: 正確：晴天假期沙灘有很多人，full of 的描述合理。

questions.meaning: 說明已打算在將來做的事；gonna 是非正式口語。
questions.usage: 談已決定的計畫，或根據眼前情況作預測時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: Our class is going to make a large paper bird for the festival on Saturday.
We are going to paint the wall tomorrow, but we finished it last year and will never paint it again.
The band is going to sing tomorrow, but the concert ended forever yesterday.
She is going to danced on stage next week.
optionExplanations: 正確：班級已計畫星期六為節日製作紙鳥，時間與目的清楚。
錯誤：明天的計畫與早已完成且不再做的說法直接衝突。
錯誤：演唱會已永久結束，與明天演出的計畫不一致。
錯誤：going to 後應接原形 dance，不能用 danced。
questions.sourceWitness: I’m gonna give · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: We are going to paint the old gate.
questions.explanation: 正確：班級已計畫星期六為節日製作紙鳥，時間與目的清楚。

questions.meaning: 先說收取的人，再說給予的東西；可改寫成 give something to someone。
questions.usage: 送禮物、傳遞物品或表達付出時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The baker gave a cake his neighbour to say thanks.
The guide gave the map to us a river.
The artist gave the visitors small pictures after the show.
The robot gave the children nothing, so they each received a new toy from it.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：若先說東西，應用 gave a cake to his neighbour。
錯誤：句尾多出 a river，不能這樣接在雙受詞結構後。
正確：畫家把小畫送給參觀者，收取者和禮物位置正確。
錯誤：機器人既沒有給東西，又被說成送了每人玩具，前後不一致。
questions.sourceWitness: give you my heart · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: Dad gave me a small camera.
questions.explanation: 正確：畫家把小畫送給參觀者，收取者和禮物位置正確。

questions.word: light + object + up / light up + object
questions.meaning: 使地方變亮；也可比喻讓某人的表情變得開心。
questions.usage: 描寫燈光、節日或讓人精神一振的事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The lights lit up the dark road because every light was switched off.
The paper fish lit up the room with its loud singing, though it had no lights.
The candles lit up the sea from a town a thousand miles away.
The lights on the boats lit up the river at night.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：所有燈都關掉，便不能以亮光照亮道路。
錯誤：沒有光源的紙魚靠唱歌令房間變亮，與字面用法不符。
錯誤：遠處城鎮的蠟燭無法照亮相隔千里的海面。
正確：船燈在夜裏照亮河面，使用和情境都自然。
questions.sourceWitness: light up the path · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: The lanterns lit up the bridge.
questions.explanation: 正確：船燈在夜裏照亮河面，使用和情境都自然。

questions.meaning: 表達自己對選擇沒有強烈偏好；語氣較直接。
questions.usage: 別人問你要選甚麼，而兩個選擇對你都可以時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: We can use the green tent or the yellow one. I don’t care; both are fine.
The only safe boat has a hole in it, but I don’t care; we must use it.
The museum is on fire, but I don’t care because fire is always safe.
I don’t care which cake we choose, but I will only accept the blue cake.
optionExplanations: 正確：兩個帳篷都可以，表達沒有偏好。
錯誤：船有洞涉及安全，不適合以不在乎作為使用理由。
錯誤：火災有危險，並非合理的無所謂選擇。
錯誤：說不介意選哪個，卻只接受一個選項，意思衝突。
questions.sourceWitness: I don’t care · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: We can sit near the door or the window. I don’t care.
questions.explanation: 正確：兩個帳篷都可以，表達沒有偏好。

questions.word: go on and + base verb (encouraging command)
questions.meaning: 叫對方繼續做或放心做某事；可帶鼓勵、挑戰或不耐煩語氣。
questions.usage: 鼓勵別人採取行動、接著說下去，或提出挑戰時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: Go on and open the box, but you must keep it closed forever.
Go on and tell your story; I never want to hear any of it.
Go on and show us your trick! We are ready to watch.
Go on and take the next step while standing still and not moving at all.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：叫人打開盒子，卻要求永遠保持關閉，指示相反。
錯誤：鼓勵繼續說故事，卻表示完全不想聽，語意不一致。
正確：觀眾準備好後鼓勵魔術師表演，符合指令功能。
錯誤：要求往前走一步，同時完全不移動，動作矛盾。
questions.sourceWitness: go on and tear · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: Go on and try the puzzle.

pattern.text: [鼓勵對方繼續／開始做的動作]

questions.explanation: 正確：觀眾準備好後鼓勵魔術師表演，符合指令功能。

questions.meaning: 字面指撕成碎片；比喻可指令人十分難過。
questions.usage: 描述紙張被撕碎，或情感受到強烈傷害時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: She tore the paper apart by putting it safely in a box without touching it.
The chef tore the water apart and served it in a cup.
The children tore the old paper apart to make small pieces for their art.
The old map was torn apart, but it was still one perfect piece.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：紙只是被好好放著，不能因此說已經撕碎。
錯誤：水不能像紙一樣被撕成碎片。
正確：把舊紙撕成小片做美勞，符合 tear ... apart 的字面用法。
錯誤：地圖既被撕碎又完全是一張完好的紙，互相矛盾。
questions.sourceWitness: tear me apart · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: The child tore the old map apart.
questions.explanation: 正確：把舊紙撕成小片做美勞，符合 tear ... apart 的字面用法。

questions.meaning: 即使某種情況出現，說話者也不在意或不打算改變決定。
questions.usage: 想表示某個條件不會影響自己的態度或選擇時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I don’t care if the seats are wet, so I will only sit on a dry seat and will leave otherwise.
I don’t care if the gate is closed, because I must see it open before I can go in.
I don’t care if I lose my ticket, but losing it is the only thing that will stop me.
I don’t care if the chairs are old; I can still enjoy the film.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：聲稱不介意座位濕，卻把乾座位當成唯一條件。
錯誤：句子承認閘門是否關閉會影響能否入內，與不在意的用法衝突。
錯誤：聲稱不在意遺失門票，卻說這是唯一會阻止自己的事。
正確：椅子雖然舊，仍可享受電影，條件不影響態度。
questions.sourceWitness: I don’t care if · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.cue: I don’t care if you do
questions.example: I don’t care if it is cold; I still want to swim.
questions.explanation: 正確：椅子雖然舊，仍可享受電影，條件不影響態度。

questions.word: do as a substitute for an earlier action
questions.meaning: 用 do 等形式代替前面已提到的動作，避免重複。
questions.usage: 上句已清楚交代動作，下一句要再提同一動作時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: Please send the photo. If you do, I will never receive the photo you send.
If you do, I will bring it; I have not mentioned any action and nobody knows what do means.
The dog can read a book. If it do, it will tell me the ending.
You can send me a photo. If you do, I will show it to my grandma.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：寄出照片與「永遠收不到已寄出的同一照片」互相矛盾。
錯誤：前文沒有可代替的動作，do 的指涉不清楚。
錯誤：主詞 it 在現在式應使用 does；整個情境也不自然。
正確：do 代替前句的 send me a photo，避免重複。
questions.sourceWitness: if you do · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: You may call me tonight. If you do, I will answer.
questions.explanation: 正確：do 代替前句的 send me a photo，避免重複。

questions.meaning: 表達想法或推測，不表示已經完全證實。
questions.usage: 根據線索提出判斷、但仍保留不確定性時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I think the key is in my shoe, because I can see it on the table in front of me.
I think I left my hat on the train; I cannot find it after the trip.
I think we are at sea, but we are standing in the middle of a desert with no water.
I think the box is empty because I have counted the ten books inside it.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：明明看見鑰匙在桌上，卻推測在鞋裏，證據不支持。
正確：旅程後找不到帽子，因此推測留在火車上。
錯誤：人在沙漠中央，沒有合理線索支持身處海上。
錯誤：已數到盒內十本書，就不能合理推測盒子是空的。
questions.sourceWitness: I think I see · supplied song PDF, lyric page(s) 2.
questions.example: I think the museum is open today.
questions.explanation: 正確：旅程後找不到帽子，因此推測留在火車上。

questions.word: I think + past-tense clause (a past guess)
questions.meaning: 現在回想過去的事，表示不太肯定自己當時看到或聽到甚麼。
questions.usage: 對先前發生的事只有模糊記憶時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I think I saw the bird yesterday, so I am watching it fly right now for the first time.
I think I saw a whale yesterday, but yesterday has not happened yet.
I think I saw the lights last night, though I know I was asleep the entire night and saw nothing.
I think I saw a deer near the trees this morning, but I am not sure.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：前句說昨天可能看過，後句卻把現在當作第一次見到，前後不順。
錯誤：昨天已經過去，不能說它尚未發生。
錯誤：已確定整夜沒有看到任何東西，不能據此合理推測看見燈。
正確：用現在的推測回想早上的可能所見，時間與不確定語氣合理。

questions.meaning: 表示希望或想要做某件事；wanna 是口語縮寫。
questions.usage: 分享自己的願望、請求或計畫時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: I want to learn to bake bread, so I have joined a baking class.
I want to bake bread, so I will never go near an oven or learn how to make it.
She wants to baking bread with her aunt on Sunday.
I want to taste the cake, so I promise I will not taste any cake.
optionExplanations: 正確：想學焗麵包而報名課堂，願望和行動一致。
錯誤：想學焗麵包，卻拒絕一切學習和使用焗爐，行動不合。
錯誤：want to 後應接原形 bake，而非 baking。
錯誤：想試食蛋糕卻保證完全不試食，意思矛盾。

questions.meaning: 描述程度發生變化，如變得更亮、更冷、更快。
questions.usage: 想說明一個狀態隨時間改變時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The ice gets colder when it lies in the hot sun for hours without any ice left.
The room gets brighter when we cover every window and switch off every light.
The snow gets smaller as the warm sun melts it.
The music gets louder when we turn its sound down to zero.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：冰在烈日下全部融掉後，不能以此說明它變得更冷。
錯誤：遮住窗戶並關燈，不會使房間更亮。
正確：太陽融化積雪，積雪逐漸變少，變化合理。
錯誤：聲音調至零應變得更安靜，不會更響。

questions.meaning: 表示某一情況越……，另一情況就越……；兩個變化有連動關係。
questions.usage: 想解釋兩種程度如何一起改變時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: The more air we put into the balloon, the bigger it becomes.
The higher the balloon goes, the closer it gets to the ground every second.
The more tickets we sell, the fewer people have bought tickets, although nobody gets a refund.
The longer the ice sits in the sun, the harder it becomes because it melts into water.
optionExplanations: 正確：充入更多空氣使氣球變大，兩種變化合理連動。
錯誤：熱氣球越升越高，通常不會同時越靠近地面。
錯誤：沒有退票下賣出更多票，不會使購票人數減少。
錯誤：冰在陽光下融化通常變成水，不是越來越硬。

questions.meaning: 強調某個人或事物非常具有某種特質，可表示驚喜、讚賞或感嘆。
questions.usage: 覺得一場表演、一份禮物或一個景象特別令人印象深刻時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最正確地運用了以上的句型及其功能？
options: It was such a funny shows that everyone laughed.
It was such a funny show that even the quiet baby laughed.
It was such a fun that all the children clapped.
It was such a loudly play that we covered our ears.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：shows 是複數，不能與 such a 連用。
正確：such a funny show 強調木偶劇非常有趣，形式和情境都吻合。
錯誤：fun 在這個意思下不是可數單數名詞，應說 such fun。
錯誤：loudly 是副詞，應用形容詞 loud 修飾 play。
